# Clever Cloud Documentation

> Clever Cloud is a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) cloud provider, an automated hosting platform for developers. Deploy your app easily and launch dependencies without having to worry about the infrastructure set up.

## API
- [APIv4 Reference](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/api/v4/index.html.md): Reference documentation for the Clever Cloud APIv4 for billing, deployments, load balancers, logs, operators, etc.
- [Clever Cloud API Overview](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/api/howto/index.html.md): Getting started with the Clever Cloud API

## Add-ons
- [Apache Pulsar](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/pulsar/index.html.md): Deploy Apache Pulsar messaging add-on service for real-time data streaming and pub-sub messaging with enterprise scalability features
- [Cellar, S3-compatible object storage service](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/cellar/index.html.md): Deploy Cellar S3-compatible object storage add-on service on Clever Cloud for scalable file storage and content delivery in your applications
- [Configuration provider](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/config-provider/index.html.md): Manage application configuration with Config Provider add-on service for centralized environment variable management and secure storage
- [CouchBase](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/couchbase/index.html.md): Deploy Couchbase NoSQL database add-on service on Clever Cloud with automatic scaling, backup capabilities, and enterprise support
- [Elastic Stack](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/elastic/index.html.md): Deploy Elasticsearch Platinum service add-on on Clever Cloud for powerful search, analytics, and data processing capabilities
- [File System Buckets](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/fs-bucket/index.html.md): Configure FS Bucket add-on service for persistent file storage and data management across your Clever Cloud applications
- [Heptapod](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/heptapod/index.html.md): Deploy Heptapod source code management platform add-on service on Clever Cloud for Git and Mercurial repository hosting with integrated CI/CD
- [Jenkins](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/jenkins/index.html.md): Set up Jenkins CI/CD automation server on Clever Cloud for continuous integration and deployment workflows with scalable infrastructure
- [Keycloak](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/keycloak/index.html.md): Deploy Keycloak identity and access management solution add-on service on Clever Cloud with one-click installation and enterprise-grade security
- [KMS (Key Management Service)](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/kms/index.html.md): Store secrets distributed across 3 data centers, compatible with existing HashiCorp Vault/Bao ecosystems
- [MailPace](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/mailpace/index.html.md): Configure MailPace email delivery add-on service for reliable transactional email sending in your Clever Cloud applications
- [Materia KV](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/materia-kv/index.html.md): Deploy Materia key-value store distributed across 3 datacenters, storage-based, resilient and compatible with existing Redis ecosystems
- [Materia TS](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/materia-ts/index.html.md): Deploy Materia Time Series store distributed across 3 datacenters, storage-based, resilient and compatible with Warp 10 ecosystem
- [Matomo](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/matomo/index.html.md): Deploy Matomo web analytics platform add-on service on Clever Cloud for privacy-focused website and application analytics with GDPR compliance
- [Metabase](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/metabase/index.html.md): Deploy Metabase business intelligence add-on service for data visualization, dashboards, and analytics reporting on Clever Cloud
- [MongoDB](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/mongodb/index.html.md): Deploy MongoDB database add-on service on Clever Cloud with automatic scaling, backups for robust NoSQL applications
- [MySQL](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/mysql/index.html.md): Deploy MySQL relational database add-on service on Clever Cloud with automated backups, scaling for enterprise applications
- [Otoroshi with LLM](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/otoroshi/index.html.md): Deploy Otoroshi API gateway on Clever Cloud for advanced API management, security, traffic control, and LLM models management
- [PostgreSQL](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/postgresql/index.html.md): Deploy PostgreSQL database add-on service on Clever Cloud with automated backups, scaling for enterprise applications
- [Redis](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/redis/index.html.md): Deploy Redis in-memory data store add-on service for caching, session management, and message brokering on Clever Cloud platform

## Administrate
- [Activity](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/activity/index.html.md): Monitor and manage activity logs for your Clever Cloud applications including deployments, scaling events, and system activities
- [Application Management](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/apps-management/index.html.md): Manage your applications on Clever Cloud including deployment configuration, scaling settings, and operational controls
- [Application Scaling](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/scalability/index.html.md): Configure automatic and manual scaling for your Clever Cloud applications to handle traffic spikes and optimize resource usage
- [ClamAV](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/clamav/index.html.md): Set up ClamAV antivirus scanning for your Clever Cloud applications to enhance security and protect against malware threats
- [CRON](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/cron/index.html.md): Schedule and manage CRON jobs on Clever Cloud for automated tasks, background processing, and periodic maintenance operations
- [Database Migration](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/database-migration/index.html.md): Manage database migrations on Clever Cloud including backup procedures, migration strategies, and data transfer best practices
- [Domain Names](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/domain-names/index.html.md): Configure and manage custom domain names for your Clever Cloud applications including DNS setup and SSL certificate management
- [Encryption at rest](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/encryption-at-rest/index.html.md): Learn how to manage encryption at rest for your add-ons on Clever Cloud, enhancing data security by encrypting data stored on disk
- [Installing TLS Certificates](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/ssl/index.html.md): Configure SSL certificates and HTTPS encryption for your Clever Cloud applications to ensure secure communications and data protection
- [Log Management](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/log-management/index.html.md): Access and manage application logs on Clever Cloud for debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting your deployed applications
- [Networking and IP addresses ranges](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/network/index.html.md): Understand Clever Cloud IP ranges for external service filtering, whitelist configuration, and unique IP services
- [Service Dependencies](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/service-dependencies/index.html.md): Configure logical dependencies between applications and add-ons to create a structured microservices topology on Clever Cloud
- [SSH access to running instances](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/ssh-clever-tools/index.html.md): Use SSH and Clever Tools CLI to manage your applications remotely including deployment, debugging, and administration tasks
- [TCP Redirections](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/tcp-redirections/index.html.md): Manage and configure TCP redirections and port forwarding for your Clever Cloud applications to enable custom networking configurations
- [Zone Migration](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/administrate/zone-migration/index.html.md): Migrate applications between Clever Cloud zones for improved performance, compliance, or geographic distribution requirements

## Applications
- [.NET](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/dotnet/index.html.md): Deploy .NET applications on Clever Cloud with support for C#, F#, VB.NET projects using cross-platform runtime capabilities
- [Docker](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/docker/index.html.md): Deploy Docker containers on Clever Cloud with secure VM isolation, custom stacks, and flexible application deployment options
- [Elixir](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/elixir/index.html.md): Deploy Elixir applications on Clever Cloud using the functional, concurrent programming language that runs on the Erlang virtual machine
- [FrankenPHP application runtime](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/frankenphp/index.html.md): Deploy PHP applications with FrankenPHP modern server based on Caddy, written in Go for enhanced performance on Clever Cloud
- [Go](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/golang/index.html.md): Deploy Go applications on Clever Cloud using the open source, compiled, garbage-collected, concurrent system programming language
- [Haskell](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/haskell/index.html.md): Deploy Haskell applications on Clever Cloud with automatic dependency management, compilation, and runtime environment configuration
- [Java](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/java/index.html.md): Deploy Java applications on Clever Cloud using Gradle, Maven, or JAR/WAR/EAR formats with framework-specific deployment guides
- [Linux application runtime](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/linux/index.html.md): Build and deploy any application with Mise and your favorite tools on Clever Cloud using flexible Linux runtime environment
- [Meteor.js](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/meteor/index.html.md): Deploy Meteor.js applications on Clever Cloud with automatic build process, dependency management, and MongoDB integration
- [Node.js & Bun runtime](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/nodejs/index.html.md): Deploy JavaScript applications on Clever Cloud with Node.js runtime and npm, or alternative tools like Bun, Deno, pnpm or Yarn
- [PHP with Apache application runtime](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/php/index.html.md): Deploy PHP applications on Clever Cloud with Apache, PHP-FPM, Composer dependencies, and framework support
- [Python application runtime](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/python/index.html.md): Deploy Python 2 and 3 applications with uv support, Django, Flask, various frameworks, and configurable runtime settings
- [Ruby on Rails](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/ruby/index.html.md): Deploy Ruby on Rails web applications with full-stack framework capabilities including database integration and template rendering
- [Rust](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/rust/index.html.md): Deploy Rust applications on Clever Cloud using the system programming language that runs blazingly fast and guarantees thread safety
- [Scala](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/scala/index.html.md): Deploy Scala applications on Clever Cloud using the object-functional programming language that runs on the Java platform runtime
- [Static Site Generators (SSGs) runtime](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/static/index.html.md): Deploy static websites with automatic builds supporting Astro, Docusaurus, Hugo, mdBook, and Mkdocs generators on pico instances
- [Static with Apache](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/static-apache/index.html.md): Deploy static files and SPAs using Apache HTTP server with .htaccess support, redirections, and access control capabilities
- [V (Vlang) application runtime](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/applications/v/index.html.md): Build and deploy V (Vlang) applications using the simple, fast, and safe programming language with built-in web server support

- [Load testing](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/best-practices/load-testing/index.html.md): Learn performance testing considerations, best practices, and requirements for load testing applications on Clever Cloud infrastructure

- [Logs Drains](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/cli/logs-drains/index.html.md): Manage log drains using Clever Tools CLI for centralized logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting capabilities
- [Network Groups](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/cli/network-groups/index.html.md): Configure and manage Network Groups using Clever Tools CLI for secure application communication and network isolation policies

- [Operators](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/cli/operators/index.html.md): Manage Keycloak, Matomo, Metabase, and Otoroshi operators directly from Clever Tools CLI with administrative commands and configurations
- [Profiles and Overrides](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/cli/profiles/index.html.md): Manage multiple Clever Tools profiles and configure per-profile overrides for custom Clever Cloud deployments
- [Services Dependencies](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/cli/services-depedencies/index.html.md): Configure and manage service dependencies using Clever Tools CLI including linking applications and managing environment connections
